findings.evidence: Phrase: "a music platform removed fifty million AI tracks it called slop" vs. source: "Spotify says it has removed more than 50 million songs considered AI-generated slop or spam from user recommendations" (The Verge).
findings.suggestion: Clarify that the tracks were removed from recommendations/visibility, not deleted from the platform entirely, e.g. "pulled fifty million AI tracks it called slop from its recommendations."
